description: Defines the MapDataset template class which applies a transformation to a source dataset, including methods for batching, size retrieval, and resetting datasets. Also includes a factory function for creating MapDataset instances.

classes.name: MapDataset
classes.description: A template class that applies a transformation to each batch of a source dataset, supporting both stateful and stateless datasets.

methods.name: get_batch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch from the dataset and applies the transformation.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the dataset if available.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the underlying dataset if it supports reset.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Returns the transformation applied to the dataset.
